content_sections.heading: About NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: NIPER-Guwahati describes itself as the only National Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences in the entire North Eastern Region, established in 2008 to provide pharmaceutical education and research focused on natural and synthetic products of the region for drug discovery and development. The Government of India approved its Incubation Center, Bio-NEST NIPER-Guwahati (North-Eastern Societal aspect for Translational Phytopharmaceutical/ Herbal Research). The centre is funded by BIRAC, Department of Biotechnology, Government of India, under the Bio-NEST (Bioincubator Nurturing Entrepreneurship for Scaling Technology) Scheme, and is operated and managed by NIPER-Guwahati. The Incubation Manager is recruited for this centre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only candidates of Indian Nationality can apply for this post. The qualifications and experience printed for the Incubation Manager are: Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Age will be calculated as on the last date of application, i.e., 08.12.2026. Age relaxation: The age limits are further relaxable for reserved categories as per GoI norms. In addition, on the recommendation of the Screening/Selection Committee, the competent authority may relax all or any of the requirements related to age and experience in exceptionally meritorious cases. Fulfilment of qualifications and experience is an essential requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.details: Post-Graduation in Business Management/ Technology/Allied Science, minimum 60%
PhD in Life Sciences/ Allied Areas/ Technology preferable; minimum 6 years of work experience in the relevant field excluding the duration of Ph.D.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Incubation Manager receives a consolidated amount of 75,000/-; the notice names no other allowance. All appointments are on a contract of one year or less if the project is terminated earlier. The appointment is against a temporary project position and will not continue in any circumstances beyond the duration of the project. Any subsequent contract in the project or another project will be a fresh appointment. The appointment in the outside-funded project gives no claim whatsoever for appointment/regularization against any Institute post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: Arrange soft copies of all required documents before filling out the application. Open the prescribed format (Google Form), available on the website www.niperguwahati.ac.in ; the application link given in the notice is https://forms.gle/4GTXTJBGd83f22bSA . Fill out the application online between 17.11.2026 and 08.12.2026 at 11:59 PM. No other form of application will be entertained. Attach the supporting documents: self-attested copies of date of birth proof, degrees, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates. Check the data before submitting: an application once submitted cannot be altered or resubmitted, and no request to change any data will be entertained. Candidates employed in Government Organizations (e.g., CFTIs, Autonomous Institutions, Universities) must apply through the proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. They may send advance applications, but if shortlisted, they can take part in the selection process only if the application is received through the proper channel and/or an NOC is produced on or before the interview date. If selected, they must produce a Relieving Letter at the time of reporting for duty.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications will be screened on the basis of the data submitted in the online application form. The Institute is free to set the benchmark and call only eligible candidates for the further recruitment process. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Institute website, and the notice refers to an interview for shortlisted candidates; the interview date is not specified in the notice. Intimations will be sent only by email/host on the website as per the details in the application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager post?
faq.answer: The online application through the Google Form is open from 17 November 2026 to 8 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Post-Graduation in Business Management/ Technology/Allied Science, minimum 60%. A PhD in Life Sciences/ Allied Areas/ Technology and minimum 6 years of relevant work experience excluding the Ph.D. duration are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Incubation Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, calculated as on the last date of application, 08.12.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age limits are relaxable for reserved categories as per GoI norms. The competent authority may also relax age and experience requirements in exceptionally meritorious cases on the recommendation of the Screening/Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: The Incubation Manager receives a consolidated amount of 75,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: Apply only through the Google Form available on www.niperguwahati.ac.in, with self-attested copies of date of birth proof, degrees, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates. No other form of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are screened on the basis of the data submitted in the online form, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Institute website for the further process, including the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIPER Guwahati Incubation Manager job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract of one year or less if the project is terminated earlier, against a temporary project position, and gives no claim to regularization against any Institute post.

faq.question: Q9. Do Government employees need an NOC to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates employed in Government Organizations must apply through the proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate on or before the interview date, and a Relieving Letter if selected.
